title: Borland's congressional testimony on the Langley triangle

tellings.quote: During the summer of 2012, my team was on standby for weather and I returned to my barracks on base and at approximately 0130, I saw an approximately 100 ft equilateral triangle take off from near the NASA hanger on the base

plain: In the summer of 2012, at about 1:30 in the morning, a triangle with equal sides roughly 100 feet long took off from near the NASA hangar on a military base, the base called Langley in Virginia. Dylan Borland, who was in the Air Force there, says he saw it himself after going back to his barracks while his team waited out the weather. He told it to Congress in testimony and repeats the words on the show, and if true it means a large unknown craft was flying from a US base.
